notes:
CHR-889. Screens view of a freshly created project with zero screens. Exploration history: mockup `empty-project-canvas` (variants A-C); this screen is the reworked final direction.

Decision (Christian, after preview): in the empty state there is NO white screen frame. The how-to-start guide sits directly on the grey canvas, centred, at native app size - it is not zoom-scaled (no transform), so the Fit/50/100/200 buttons do not affect it. Calmer than the earlier in-frame version.

Layout: Screens panel stays expanded (280px) but empty - filter field + "0 screens · 0 mockups", no "No screens yet." text; Context and Elements are 36px icon rails (CHR-888, same markup as sidebars-collapsed); the grey "No screens yet." column is gone. Canvas = $color.canvas.

Final copy (English):
- Label: "GET STARTED"
- Title: "Design your first screen"
- 1: "Ask your AI tool to design a screen in this project."  then prompt block (mono) "Design a login screen in my Artisign project artisign-ui"  [Copy]
- 2: "Watch it appear here while the agent works."
- 3: "Review it. Use Comment mode to leave feedback the agent reads."

Sizes / tokens (all token refs, zero drift): content column 480px wide, centred in the canvas both ways; gap between head and steps $spacing.2xl, between steps $spacing.xl, step icon-to-text $spacing.lg. Label $typography.size-2xs, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.04em, $color.text-label. Title $typography.size-xl / $typography.weight-semibold, $color.text. Step text $typography.size-base, line-height 22px, $color.text-secondary. Number badge 22px circle ($radius.pill, $color.accent on $color.accent-subtle, $typography.size-xs, semibold). Prompt block: $color.surface, 1px $color.border-strong, $radius.sm, padding $spacing.lg $spacing.xl; prompt text $typography.family-mono at $typography.size-sm, $color.text-secondary; Copy = small button on the right of the block (1px $color.border-strong, $radius.sm, $typography.size-xs semibold, padding $spacing.xs $spacing.lg). The prompt block sits under step 1, aligned with the step text (indented past the badge). Literal values with no token: 480px width, 22px badge/line-height.

Behaviour: the guide renders only while the project has zero screens and disappears live the moment the first screen arrives (the canvas then shows that screen as usual, no reload). The prompt names the open project - the project picker value, here "artisign-ui" (it replaces the name in the prompt; it must always match the picker). Copy copies exactly the prompt text and the label flips to "Copied" for ~1.5s; the prompt text is also selectable. Not a dialog: no close button, no dismissal - it is state.

Design-file artefact: `$topbar` has no slot for the project name or zoom state, so it renders "artisign-ui" with Fit active; in the product the picker and the prompt show the open project's name.
